territories.name: North Macedonia
territories.legal_reference: Directive 2006/112/EC, article 5(2): the common system of VAT applies in the territory of the Community as defined by the Treaties, and a State outside it is a third country for every rule the Directive carries, candidate for accession or not. North Macedonia levies a value added tax of its own, Данок на додадена вредност, under the Law on Value Added Tax (consolidated text), articles 28 to 30-б, which set the standard rate of 18% and the reduced rates of 10% and 5%.
